abilities.name: Judgement
abilities.description: Changed: it no longer eats your seal. 10 yd range, 10 sec cooldown. Judging Seal of Fury taunts for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Seal of Fury
abilities.description: The tank seal: every hit adds Holy damage, and with a shield up an absorb worth half of it. Level 10, ranks to 58.

abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.description: Baseline Ret strike, 10 sec cooldown: weapon damage plus Holy. Level 6, ranks to 60. Several talents build on it.

abilities.name: Blessing of Kings and Consecration
abilities.description: Both trainable now, not talents. Consecration at level 20.

abilities.name: Shadow Word: Death
abilities.description: New Shadow nuke, 15 sec cooldown, ranks at 32, 40, 48 and 56. If the target survives you take 10% of your max health. Early Demise adds 15 or 30% crit on targets at or below 20% health.

abilities.name: Devouring Plague
abilities.description: A normal Shadow spell now, not an Undead racial. 1 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fear Ward
abilities.description: Every Priest gets it. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.description: Trainable now, not a talent, and quicker: 2 sec cast (Classic 3), 6 sec cooldown shared with Multi-Shot. Level 20, ranks to 60. A reader caught the cast time on Xaryu's stream.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Beast
abilities.description: Changed: rank 1 makes you untrackable and adds 50 melee attack power (Classic: untrackable only). Spotted by a reader on Xaryu's stream.

abilities.name: Comprehend Scroll
abilities.description: New little ability: decipher an untranslated scroll. Level 6.

abilities.name: Frostfire Bolt
abilities.description: New at 40, ranks at 50 and 60: a bolt that is both Fire and Frost. Missile Barrage, Improved Fireball and Heating Up name it.

abilities.name: Subjugate Demon
abilities.description: Enslave Demon, renamed.

abilities.name: Bane of Agony
abilities.description: Curse of Agony, renamed. Bane of Doom the same. Banes and Curses are separate now, so you can run one of each.

abilities.name: Incubus
abilities.description: Male counterpart to the Succubus, its own summon. Named by four Demonology talents.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.description: From damage taken and your swings. Slower weapons give more Rage a swing, so it comes in at a steady rate. Out of combat you lose 1.25 Rage a second. From the Rage tooltip and Blizzard's Class Highlights video (0:23).

abilities.name: Victory Rush
abilities.description: Baseline, Arms tab. Instant, 30 sec cooldown: a melee hit that heals 10% of your max health, within 20 sec of a non-trivial kill. Read off Soda's stream via a reader.

abilities.name: Tactical Mastery
abilities.description: A passive in the Arms tab now, not a talent: keep up to 10 Rage when you change stances, and Improved Tactical Mastery adds up to 15 more. From Soda's Warrior video via a reader.

abilities.name: Intercept
abilities.description: Unchanged from Classic: level 30 in the Fury tab, ranks at 42 and 52. Improved Intercept stays in the Fury tree.

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: A new rank 1 at 20; Classic's four ranks follow at 30, 38, 46 and 54, one rank number higher. 18 sec cooldown now (Classic had none).

abilities.name: Thunder Clap
abilities.description: Works in Battle or Defensive Stance. Rank 4 slows attacks 20% for 22 sec on up to 4 targets (Classic 10%). Xaryu's stream via a reader; the Classic number from the files.

abilities.name: Bloodrage
abilities.description: Still there, Protection tab: 20% of your base health for 10 Rage, plus 10 more over 10 sec.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Changed: 15 min cooldown, 60% less damage for 12 sec (Classic 30 min, 75% for 10 sec). No shared cooldown with Retaliation and Recklessness any more: each has its own timer, and Blizzard's Class Highlights video (1:14) says so. Two readers flagged it first.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.description: Changed: 2 charges and 7 sec (Classic 1 block for 5 sec). Still 10 Rage, 5 sec cooldown, Defensive Stance. From a Tyler1 spellbook screenshot a reader sent in.

abilities.name: Energy
abilities.description: Comes back 1 point every 0.1 sec, 10 a second: Classic's rate with no tick to wait for. From the Energy tooltip and Blizzard's Class Highlights video (3:41).

abilities.name: Mutilate
abilities.description: New talent, Assassination row 5: both weapons at 75% each, 20% more on poisoned targets, 2 combo points. Remorseless Attacks, Lethality, Cold Blood, Puncturing Wounds and Opportunity name it.

abilities.name: Venom
abilities.description: New finisher at the bottom of Assassination. Your poisons do 30% more and apply 10% more often, longer per combo point.

abilities.name: Thousand Cuts
abilities.description: New Subtlety capstone. Each Rupture tick takes 3 Energy off your next Hemorrhage or Backstab, stacking to 5.

abilities.name: Axes
abilities.description: Rogues can use one-handed axes now. The Hack and Slash talent lists Axe/Sword as a weapon group.

abilities.name: Omen of Clarity and Nature's Grasp
abilities.description: Both trainable now, not talents, in the Balance tab: Nature's Grasp at 10, Omen of Clarity (a passive now) at 20.

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.description: New out-of-combat resurrection, 10 sec cast. Rebirth keeps its 30 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.description: Bear bleed from later expansions, baseline here; Shredding Attacks cuts its Rage cost. Level 42, ranks at 50 and 58. Thanks to a reader.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.description: Still here: level 14 from the quest Power over Poison, as in Classic. Since build 70170 High Order Skyborne can take that quest too (Blizzard's notes).

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.description: Ranks 4 to 10 cast in 2.5 sec, half a second under Classic's 3. Ranks 1 to 3 keep 1.5, 2 and 2.5 sec.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Also half a second faster: rank 1 is a 2 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown, 3 targets, each jump 30% weaker. Max Elemental Alacrity brings Lightning Bolt to the same 2 sec.

abilities.name: Totemic Projection
abilities.description: New: pick a spot up to 30 yd away and your totems move there. Seen on Guzu's stream. Totemic Recall is in too.

abilities.name: Totems last 5 min
abilities.description: Lasting totems last 5 min now (most were 2 min in Classic; Healing Stream and Mana Spring 1 min). Searing (30 to 55 sec by rank), Magma (20), Stoneclaw (15), Earthbind and Grounding (45) and Mana Tide (12) keep their short timers. Blizzard's Class Highlights video (3:00) says five minutes.

abilities.name: Call of the Elements, Ancestors and Spirits
abilities.description: New: each drops up to four totems from its own Totem Bar set in one 3 sec cast. Elements at 20, Ancestors at 30, Spirits at 40.

abilities.name: Fire Nova
abilities.description: A spell now, not a totem: 30 yd range, instant, 10 sec cooldown, blasts everything within 10 yd of your Fire totem (rank 3 at 32: 195 to 219; rank 5 at 52: 413 to 459). Improved Fire Nova trims 2 or 4 sec off the cooldown.
